title: Tax invoices
intro: Invoices issued to the client under ZATCA e-invoicing. A draft can change; an issued invoice is a regulated document corrected only by a credit note.
empty: No invoices for this unit yet.

identity.title: Company tax identity
identity.intro: What every issued tax invoice prints about your company: the registered legal name, VAT registration, commercial registration and national address.
identity.incomplete: The tax identity is incomplete — invoicing is disabled until every field is set.
identity.complete: The tax identity is complete. Invoicing is enabled.

errors.SELLER_IDENTITY_INCOMPLETE: Complete the company tax identity in Settings before invoicing.
errors.SELLER_VAT_INVALID: A KSA VAT registration is 15 digits, starting and ending with 3.
errors.BUYER_VAT_REQUIRED: A standard (B2B) invoice needs the buyer's VAT registration.
errors.TAX_INVOICE_ISSUE_RACE: Another invoice was issued at the same moment — try again.
errors.UBL_BUYER_ADDRESS_REQUIRED: A standard invoice needs the buyer's address to issue.
